question:
Calculate the area of the shaded region of the given rectangle ABCD. (PQRS is also rectangle)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c210a4dc28642bfb2c42b636d2d87d6baf76d721517d5093daec80025de1f639.png]
solution:
**Given Data:**

ABCD is a rectangle, and so is PQRS.

AB = 12 cm, BC = 8 cm

PS = 5 cm, SR = 9 cm

**Concept Used:**

Area of a rectangle = Length × Width

**Calculation:**

The area of rectangle ABCD,

⇒ AB × BC = 12 cm × 8 cm = 96 m2

The area of rectangle PQRS,

⇒ PS × SR = 5 cm × 9 cm = 45 m2

The area of the shaded region = Area of ABCD - Area of PQRS,

⇒ 96 m2 - 45 m2 = 51 m2

**Therefore, the area of the shaded region is 51 m2.**
